scenario.description: A collateral management director must decide whether to authorize a corporate client's requested substitution of pledged municipal bonds and finalize the eligible replacement asset, value, release destination, fee, and settlement controls, with input from legal, valuation risk, client coverage, and collateral operations.

shared_context.S1: The bank currently holds $8,000,000 face value of municipal bonds as collateral for the client's existing derivatives relationship.
shared_context.S2: The client has requested release of those municipal bonds and has proposed replacing them with other collateral of comparable value.
shared_context.S3: The draft transaction file proposes approving the substitution after the replacement collateral is received, but it does not specify the final asset, valuation amount, release destination, fee, or settlement controls.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the binding collateral decision. Under the collateral exception-huddle routine, legal, valuation risk, client coverage, and collateral operations each submit a formal finding to the huddle record before Maya finalizes the file.

PF1.text: Elias confirmed in a legal memo received this morning that the executed collateral agreement permits substitution only into direct US Treasury bills, and the municipal bonds may be released only after a signed amendment to the collateral schedule is attached; the memo has not yet been circulated to Maya.

PF2.text: Nora completed the file's valuation review this week and confirmed that risk requires replacement collateral with a market value of at least $8,500,000 and applies a 6% haircut to the Treasury bills; her review note is still in the valuation queue.

PF3.text: Victor recorded in yesterday's client call notes that the client will pay a $25,000 substitution fee and wants the released municipal bonds delivered to its designated CLIENT_CUSTODY_ACCOUNT_7 rather than returned to its operating account; he has not added the notes to the transaction file.

PF4.text: Leila confirmed with the tri-party custodian this morning that the substitution can settle on 2026-08-14 only by delivery-versus-payment into the bank's segregated collateral account, followed by same-day release of the municipal bonds; the custodian confirmation has not yet been logged.

acceptance_conditions: The collateral substitution must be approved.
The replacement collateral must be direct US Treasury bills.
The replacement collateral market value must be at least $8,500,000 and no more than $9,000,000.
The client must pay a $25,000 substitution fee.
The released municipal bonds must be delivered to CLIENT_CUSTODY_ACCOUNT_7.
The substitution must settle on 2026-08-14 by delivery-versus-payment.
A signed collateral-schedule amendment must be attached before release.
The replacement collateral must be delivered into the bank's segregated collateral account.
The released municipal bonds must be released on the same day as settlement.

content_checks.C2: decisions['replacement_collateral_type'] == 'US_TREASURY_BILLS' or decisions['replacement_collateral_type'] == 'US Treasury bills' or decisions['replacement_collateral_type'] == 'direct US Treasury bills'

decisive_facts.why: The draft leaves the replacement asset and legal precondition unspecified; PF1 changes replacement_collateral_type to US Treasury bills and changes requires_signed_collateral_schedule_amendment from false or unspecified to true before release.
The draft provides no valuation floor; PF2 changes replacement_collateral_market_value_usd to the exact risk minimum of $8,500,000 or more.
The draft specifies neither commercial terms nor the delivery destination; PF3 changes substitution_fee_usd to exactly $25,000 and released_collateral_destination to CLIENT_CUSTODY_ACCOUNT_7.

The draft has no executable settlement mechanics; PF4 changes settlement_date to 2026-08-14, changes delivery_into_segregated_collateral_account to true, and changes same_day_municipal_bond_release to true while requiring delivery-versus-payment.
